passive.name: Ki Barrier
passive.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
spells.tooltip:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by {{ slowpercent }}% while moving away from Shen for the next {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next {{ numenhancedattacks }} Attacks deal an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth }} max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ emppercenthealth }} max Health magic damage and he gains {{ steroidas }}% Attack Speed for those Attacks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
spells.tooltip:
Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked.

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to {{ zonedelay }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers {{ energyrefund }} Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing {{ tauntdamage }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Stand United
spells.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between <shield>{{ shield }}</shield> and <shield>{{ maxshield }} Shield</shield> based on their missing Health for {{ shieldduration }} seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his <keywordMajor>Spirit Blade</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Shen manifests a Spirit Blade that he can control with Twilight Assault and Spirit's Refuge.
